provenance: Sourced from the Common Operational Dataset on administrative boundaries (COD-AB) for South Sudan: OCHA / South Sudan National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) / Inter-Cluster Information Management Working Group (ICIWG) / MapAction, 2020 boundaries, obtained via fieldmaps.io (data.fieldmaps.io/cod/originals/ssd.gpkg). Codes are the official p-codes (ADM1 = SSxx, ADM2 = SSxxyy, ADM3 = SSxxyyzz); names are the official ADM_EN spellings. Structure: 1 country, 11 admin-1 units (10 states + Abyei Region), 79 counties, 512 payams. NOTE ON VINTAGE: this operational COD carries Abyei Region as an admin-1 unit and places Pibor as a county within Jonglei; the R-ARCSS 2020 framing of three administrative areas (Abyei, Greater Pibor, Ruweng) is not separately encoded here, and a deployment should reconcile against the current NBS gazette. Boma (admin-4) and finer levels are NOT part of the official COD and are created as they are encountered, never invented.
